summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Haoxi Health Technology Ltd to report the closing of a registered direct offering. The company issued 300,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.40 per share and 9,700,000 pre-funded warrants with an exercise price of $0.33, generating $4 million in gross proceeds. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement (F-3), with Univest Securities acting as placement agent receiving a 7% cash fee. The filing also details lock-up agreements for directors, officers, and 5%+ shareholders lasting 90 days post-closing. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
